title: BACKPACK TILES SHARE ONE BORDER, RARITY IS A BAR
why: The critic held the backpack at 3 of 5 (target 4): tiles had different coloured borders and tinted fills so focus and rarity read alike, and about 60 px of dead panel sat under the hints. Every tile now has the same 1px line, rarity is a 3px bar at the foot, and the footer is shorter.
now: Backpack tiles have one border colour with a rarity bar, and the panel is trimmed to its content.

edits.replacement: if(it){ ctx.fillStyle=RCOL[dispR(stacks[si].key)]||'#4a5257'; ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty+TILE-4,TILE-2,3); }   // v28.xx (cw-bagpolish3), the critic (2026-10-20): every tile gets the same 1px line and rarity is only a 3 px bar at the foot (style guide: rarity as a bar), not a tinted fill and a coloured border
